summary: Foampunch's snowboarding game inspired by Amped and realistic board-sport videos, focused on defining a personal riding style across open mountain missions and co-op play.

entries.title: Shredders
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC or PS5 Full Ride Edition for physical collectors

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings with DLC

primary.why: Shredders released for Windows and Xbox Series X/S in March 2022, then PlayStation 5 in December 2022, with a PS5 Full Ride Edition physical package in 2025. Windows is the highest-fidelity route, while the PS5 Full Ride Edition is a useful physical complete-package alternative if its DLC bundle matters.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with owned DLC installed; use PS5 Full Ride Edition as a physical console alternative.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; Full Ride Edition is a later physical/DLC package on PS5.
